Children building robots and AI.

African children in Cameroon and Dallas–Fort Worth. A program of Glappy Foundation.

Partner with us

2027

Dallas–Fort Worth, at the scale of a season.

See the 2027 plan

A shorter school week in Bamenda. A first season still ahead in Texas.

Kids in Bamenda were in school about four days a week because of the conflict there. Kids in other parts of the country were in school five days a week. Classes began in November 2022, under Glappy Foundation, so those children could keep learning to build.

  1. Learn

    Classes with a mentor. A child takes part through a parent or guardian. Mentors are screened before they meet students. See the programs

  2. Build

    Ages 6–12 start with a hands-on build. Ages 13–17 work toward a humanoid robot. In 2027, Dallas–Fort Worth teams build small humanoid robots from open-source schematics and 3D-printed parts.

  3. Show

    Training, safety, and a showcase. Dallas–Fort Worth and Yaoundé meet on separate dates. AfroBot is hosting the Yaoundé event.

Robotics and AI

See the programs

The model

Learn, build, and show the work.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Ages 6–9. Teams build a life-size vehicle by hand.

  2. 02

    Build

    Ages 9–12. Teams carry a life-size vehicle through a longer build.

  3. 03

    Innovate

    Ages 13–17. An AI agent is the brain of a humanoid robot.

  4. 04

    Compete

    Ages 13–17. Teams prepare humanoid robots for recognized robotics competitions.

  5. 05

    Advance

    Ages 13–17. Older students mentor younger teams with an adult coach.

30 Children in the McKinney pilot, 2024
5,000 Children trained in Cameroon
1,500 Children learning now
15 Teams

Dallas–Fort Worth, at the scale of a season.

The 2024 pilot was about 30 children. The 2027 season is about 15 teams and about 90 students, with training, safety, and a showcase. The Cameroon program continues.

The camp-week participation goal is $100 per child. Sponsor goals are on the partners page.

Interest is open. Sessions are not open for enrollment on this site yet. Other US regions, and a Dallas championship in April 2028, are proposed. Read that horizon.
